files.rationale: Both PRs replaced the unsafe sprintf in url_encode; I kept PR A's encoding loop because the auto-merged allocation already uses PR A's exact-length isalnum-based count, so the loop must use the identical predicate to stay within the buffer (PR B's differing predicate could overflow), which still fulfils PR B's goal of overrun-free encoding while retaining all other non-conflicting changes from both sides.
